chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

I am defining Islam as no one has defined before me: Islam is submission, submission is conviction, conviction is affirmation, affirmation is acknowledgement, acknowledgement is discharge (of obligations), and discharge of obligations is action.
ai.seo_question: What is the definition of Islam according to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) elucidates Islam not merely as a label but as a dynamic continuum from inner conviction (yaqin) to outward action (amal), reflecting the Shia emphasis on the unity of belief and practice. This definition underscores that true submission requires both internal certainty and external fulfillment of duties, a concept central to understanding the holistic nature of faith in Nahj al-Balagha.
